2026-01-02.text: My tent will be with them, and I will be their God.

2026-01-03.text: Zadok [was] a mighty and courageous young man.

2026-01-04.text: Adam’s life amounted to 930 years, and then he died.

2026-01-05.text: Become doers of the word and not hearers only.

2026-01-06.text: He heals the brokenhearted; he binds up their wounds.

2026-01-07.text: They were all wiped off the earth.

2026-01-08.text: Keep conquering the evil with the good.

2026-01-09.text: Where will we buy bread for these people to eat?

2026-01-10.text: The gift God gives is everlasting life by Christ Jesus our Lord.

2026-01-11.text: I have made your name known.

2026-01-12.text: Her husband rises up and praises her.

2026-01-13.text: I, Jehovah, am your God, . . . the One guiding you in the way you should walk.

2026-01-14.text: Give Jehovah the glory due his name.

2026-01-16.text: The vision is yet for its appointed time.

2026-01-17.text: Prove to yourselves the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

2026-01-18.text: These things entrust to faithful men, who, in turn, will be adequately qualified to teach others.

2026-01-19.text: David . . . , a man agreeable to my heart.

2026-01-20.text: Commit your way to Jehovah; rely on him, and he will act in your behalf

2026-01-21.text: Why are you delaying? Rise, get baptized.

2026-01-22.text: With you there is true forgiveness.

2026-01-23.text: When you make gifts of mercy, do not blow a trumpet ahead of you.

2026-01-24.text: Pay constant attention to yourself and to your teaching.

2026-01-25.text: Who can find a capable wife? Her value is far more than that of corals.

2026-01-27.text: May Jehovah, my Rock, be praised, who trains my hands for battle.

2026-01-28.text: Repent, for the Kingdom of the heavens has drawn near

2026-01-30.text: [Love] hopes all things, endures all things.

2026-01-31.text: Reprove before all onlookers those who practice sin, as a warning to the rest.
